rules.text: A change to heading 2401 from any other chapter.
A change to subheading 2402.10 from any other heading.

A change to subheadings 2402.20 through 2402.90 from any other chapter or from wrapper tobacco, not threshed or similarly processed, of heading 2401 or from homogenized or reconstituted tobacco suitable for use as wrapper tobacco of heading 2403.

(a) A change to homogenized or reconstituted tobacco for use as cigar wrapper of subheading 2403.91 from any other heading; or
(b) A change to any other goods of heading 2403 from any other chapter.
